content.text: In countries like Nigeria, Ghana, and Kenya, digital creators face a unique challenge: receiving payments for their digital products without relying on restricted platforms like [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/stripe-alternatives-nigerian-creators-honest-side-side-breakdown-3|stripe]] or PayPal. This problem is not limited to these regions; even in more developed countries, creators are forced to adapt to changing payment landscapes, often at the cost of efficiency and control. The solution lies in infrastructure sovereignty, where creators can own and operate their own digital commerce stacks, free from the constraints of traditional payment gateways. NowPayments, a cutting-edge payment processing solution, offers a viable alternative for these creators, providing a seamless and efficient way to receive [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/crypto-payments-tanzanian-online-sellers-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/everything-about-selling-design-assets-crypto-payments-guide|COREMERCH guide to everything]]-you-need|Crypto Payments]] payments for their digital products.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: Setting Up a NOWPayments Digital Store: The Full Guide at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-setting-up-nowpayments-digital-store-works-how-2. content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters

NOWPayments is a cryptocurrency payment processing solution that enables creators to receive payments for their digital products in a secure and efficient manner. Unlike traditional payment gateways, NOWPayments does not require creators to rely on platforms like Stripe or PayPal, which can impose restrictions on their businesses. By using NOWPayments, creators can maintain full control over their digital commerce stack, including the ability to choose their own payment methods, fees, and settlement currencies. This is particularly important for creators in regions where traditional payment gateways are restricted or unavailable, such as Nigeria, Ghana, and Kenya.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The NOWPayments architecture is built around a decentralized payment processing model, where transactions are verified on-chain and settled in real-time. This approach eliminates the need for intermediaries, reducing fees and increasing efficiency. When a customer makes a payment, the transaction is broadcast to the blockchain network, where it is verified and settled in a matter of seconds. The creator then receives the payment in their chosen settlement currency, which can be any cryptocurrency supported by NOWPayments.
Who This Is Built For and Why

NOWPayments is designed for digital creators who want to maintain full control over their digital commerce stack, including the ability to choose their own payment methods, fees, and settlement currencies. This is particularly important for creators in regions where traditional payment gateways are restricted or unavailable, such as Nigeria, Ghana, and Kenya. By using NOWPayments, creators can adapt to changing payment landscapes, increase efficiency, and reduce costs.
NOWPayments eliminates the need for intermediaries, reducing fees and increasing efficiency.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The NOWPayments architecture is comprised of several key components, including the payment gateway, wallet, and blockchain network. The payment gateway enables creators to receive payments from customers, while the wallet provides a secure storage solution for cryptocurrency assets. The blockchain network verifies and settles transactions in real-time, eliminating the need for intermediaries and reducing fees. This architecture is designed to be scalable, secure, and efficient, making it an attractive solution for digital creators who want to maintain full control over their digital commerce stack.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy NOWPayments and start receiving crypto payments for your digital products, follow these steps: First, sign up for a NOWPayments account and configure your payment settings. Next, integrate the NOWPayments payment gateway into your digital commerce stack, using the provided API documentation and developer resources. Finally, test your setup to ensure that payments are being processed correctly. With NOWPayments, you can start receiving payments in a secure and efficient manner, without relying on restricted platforms like Stripe or PayPal.
How do I receive crypto payments for my digital products?

The most important question a reader would ask is: How long does USDT payment take to arrive compared to PayPal? The answer is that USDT payments on Tron and Solana take under 10 seconds to settle, compared to 1-3 days for PayPal. This is because USDT payments are processed on-chain, eliminating the need for intermediaries and reducing fees.

USDT payments on Tron and Solana take under 10 seconds to settle, compared to 1-3 days for PayPal. This is because USDT payments are processed on-chain, eliminating the need for intermediaries and reducing fees.
How do creators in Nigeria convert Bitcoin to naira?

Creators in Nigeria can convert Bitcoin to naira by using a peer-to-peer exchange like Binance or Patricia. This involves creating a listing for your Bitcoin and receiving offers from buyers in naira. Once a payment is made, you can settle the transaction and receive the naira equivalent in your local bank account.

NOWPayments charges a flat fee of 0.5% per transaction, with no additional fees for payment processing, settlement, or foreign exchange conversions. This makes it an attractive solution for digital creators who want to maintain full control over their digital commerce stack and reduce costs.
